summary: Allogene Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $135 million of common stock through TD Cowen as agent. The shares are sold from time to time at prevailing market prices; no fixed price, premium, or special terms are stated. The board is not making a recommendation on this routine shelf takedown. This is an ordinary capital-raising transaction, not a special situation like a tender offer, going-private, or restructuring. The filing involves no activism, merger, or strategic review.
